description: Equip and Tech outer transitions: entry, closing and reopening; retained help, forward list scrolling with ignored early input, equipment paging bounds, and persistent equipment sort mode.
registration: Reuses the silent equipment-transitions-source-v1 recording. The Rust equipment-transitions-fixture-v2 grants all 24 Lloyd weapons (items 135-158) on the existing tech-lists fixture, keeping matching native and Dolphin state copies. Native update 64 is source VI zero with the full shared school actor, animation, effect, RNG, background-wait, save-spark and skit origin. All 1,840 observed VIs satisfy UI clock = 38084 + VI and effect clock = 37551 + VI: no source waits are removed, and no presentation/effect advances or animation overrides are used. Y first presents the menu at VI 12; all later actions take effect at source poll/2 + 1. Native action edges map to VI + 64 with release on the next update. Equip is active at VIs 223-872 and 963-1032; Tech is active at 1183-1592 and 1693-1772. Every first child frame has fade 206, and the last child frame has fade 255 before Main resumes at fade 206. All selected images retain the existing 8/1% tolerance, with Main, party and effect gates throughout and the appropriate Equip or Tech gate during each child interval. The route covers forward scrolls including ignored Up at VI 523 and 1403, C-stick page-up/down and last-page rejection, equipment sort toggle at VI 761 and its persistence after reopening, plus retained description transitions. It has no negative row-scroll offsets, shoulder button input, equipment replacement or natural acquisition; those are outside this recording. Video timestamps omit requested VIs 871 and 1031, so those absent images are excluded without changing the source input replay. Main transition state is checked only while Main is visible: its stored fade remains255 throughout child menus, whereas native child pages own independent fades.
